home.title: Armenian Pavilion — Biennale Arte 2026
home.description: Zadik Zadikian: The Studio. Curators Tony Shafrazi and Tina Chakarian. Armenian Pavilion, 61st International Art Exhibition — La Biennale di Venezia. Arsenale Militare, Tesa 41, 9 May – 22 November 2026.
walks.title: Walks
walks.description: The studio carries the works out of Tesa 41 and through Venice, sets them down in a campo, on a fondamenta or before a church, and carries them home another way. The schedule, the routes and every walk so far.
visit.title: Getting to the pavilion
visit.description: The pavilion sits inside the Arsenale, about an eight-minute walk from the crossing at the Piraeus Lion. Guests by water taxi enter from the North Lagoon. Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00–17:30, 9 May – 22 November 2026.
artist.title: Zadik Zadikian
artist.description: Sculptor. Representing Armenia at the 61st International Art Exhibition — La Biennale di Venezia.
portage.title: Portage
portage.description: In Venice everything arrives by water and leaves the quay on someone’s back. From Piazzale Roma on, whatever moves goes by boat or by hand; the studio goes one step further back, to a frame on the shoulders.
story.title: Armenian as well: Zadikian and Shafrazi
story.description: Two Armenians met in Richard Serra’s studio in 1973. Serra introduced one to the other as “Armenian as well.” Fifty-three years later they are working side by side again, inside the Venice Arsenale.
taxi.title: By water taxi: Hotel Gabrielli to the pavilion
taxi.description: From the Hotel Gabrielli landing on Riva degli Schiavoni straight to the pavilion’s own landing inside the Arsenale Militare: through the canals of Castello, out into the North Lagoon and back in through Rio delle Galeazze, 15 to 20 minutes on the water.
delivery.title: Deliveries to the Armenian Pavilion
delivery.description: How to deliver materials to the Armenian Pavilion, Tesa 41, Arsenale Militare, Venice: on foot from the Celestia or by boat.
blog.title: Journal: notes from the studio
blog.description: Process, travel and the making of The Studio, from Los Angeles to Tesa 41.
subscribed.title: You’re on the list
subscribed.description: News and events from the Armenian Pavilion, Biennale Arte 2026.
press.description: Press kit for Zadik Zadikian: The Studio, Armenian Pavilion, Biennale Arte 2026: release, fact sheet, images, films and logos.
pitch.tricolore.title: The Italian flag walks through Venice
pitch.tricolore.description: Armenian Pavilion, Biennale Arte 2026: the studio carries an Italian flag through Venice on foot. Saturday 14 November to Piazza San Marco, Wednesday 18 November to the Accademia di Belle Arti. Release, films and images.
